skill.name: invoice-organizer
skill.description: Organizes invoices and receipts for tax preparation by extracting document details, standardizing filenames, sorting files into folders, and creating accounting summaries.
skill.summary: Organize invoices and receipts into tax-ready folders with standardized names and summary reports.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: All 61 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code and fenced examples in SKILL.md, not executable Ruby backtick calls. The skill performs local invoice organization with user-visible planning and approval steps, and no prompt injection, network access, credential handling, or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Clarify that shell snippets are examples and require explicit user approval before any file changes are made.

remediation.issue: Optional automation could affect future files if created without review.
remediation.suggestion: Require a separate confirmation before creating any watcher or recurring organization script, and default to copying originals.

content.value_statement: Messy invoice folders make tax preparation slow and error-prone. This skill extracts key details, renames files, sorts records, and creates accountant-ready summaries.
actual_capabilities: Finds PDF, JPG, and PNG invoice files in a selected folder.
Extracts vendor, date, invoice number, amount, and description when readable.
Renames files with a consistent date, vendor, document type, and description pattern.
Organizes copies by vendor, expense category, time period, or tax category.
Creates a CSV summary for accountants, expense tracking, or accounting imports.
Flags unclear documents for manual review when important details are missing.
limitations: OCR accuracy depends on the quality of scans and screenshots.
Missing dates, vendors, or totals may require user review.
It does not provide tax, legal, or accounting advice.
It needs access to the folder that contains the documents.

use_cases.title: Prepare Freelancer Tax Records
use_cases.description: Turn a folder of mixed receipts into year and category folders with a summary for tax preparation.

use_cases.title: Reconcile Monthly Expenses
use_cases.description: Group last month's receipts by category, total the expenses, and identify files that need review.

use_cases.title: Clean Vendor Downloads
use_cases.description: Rename duplicate invoice downloads with clear vendor, date, and service details for easier filing.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Folder Cleanup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a messy folder
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize the invoices in this folder for tax preparation. Keep the original files and ask before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Extract and Propose
prompt_templates.prompt: Read every PDF and image receipt in this folder. Extract date, vendor, amount, invoice number, and description, then propose a folder plan by vendor.

prompt_templates.title: Category Tax Archive
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize this year's business receipts by year, expense category, and vendor. Create a CSV summary with totals and list files that need manual review.

prompt_templates.title: Monthly Workflow Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a repeatable monthly workflow for my downloaded invoices. Use a standard naming pattern, keep originals, generate summaries, and explain validation checks.

output_examples.input: A folder contains 89 files named invoice, invoice copy, and receipt image.
output_examples.output: The skill reports the detected vendors, proposes standardized names, and asks for approval before creating organized vendor folders.

output_examples.input: A business owner asks for last month's receipts by category.
output_examples.output: The skill groups receipts into software, office, travel, and services categories, then summarizes totals and review items.

output_examples.input: An accountant needs a multi-year invoice archive.
output_examples.output: The skill creates year-based folders, standardizes file names, and prepares a spreadsheet summary for review.

best_practices: Back up or copy originals before moving any invoice files.
Review the proposed filename and folder mapping before approval.
Check the CSV summary against source documents before filing taxes.
anti_patterns: Do not run bulk moves before reviewing the proposed changes.
Do not assume tax deductibility from vendor names alone.
Do not discard documents that have missing or unreadable fields.

faq.question: Can it organize scanned receipts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can read visible text from image receipts when the scan quality is good.

faq.question: Will it delete my original files?
faq.answer: The skill recommends copying files first and preserving originals unless you choose a different workflow.

faq.question: Can it create a spreadsheet for my accountant?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a CSV summary with dates, vendors, amounts, categories, and file paths.

faq.question: Does it decide which expenses are deductible?
faq.answer: No. It can organize by tax category, but a qualified professional should confirm deductibility.

faq.question: What happens when details are missing?
faq.answer: The skill can use filename or file date clues and place uncertain files into a review list.

faq.question: Can it handle multiple years of invoices?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize archives by year, quarter, vendor, or category based on your chosen structure.
